# [API] fix: handle multiple active trading sessions in /api/trading/position

User has 5 active paper bots, each with its own trading_sessions row.
.maybeSingle() without .limit(1) returns PGRST116 error when
multiple rows match. Add .order(updated_at, desc).limit(1) to fetch
the most recent active session, consistent with other trading APIs.
